sn35.151:1.1: The Vinaya establishes that a newly ordained monastic should live in dependence on a mentor (_uppajjhāya_) and/or a “tutor” (_ācariya_) for at least the first five years. If they considered qualified at that point they may be released from dependence. Here the Buddha plays with this idea, inverting the standard meaning.
sn35.151:1.6: The Buddha reveals the pun: the defilements “reside within” (_anto vasanti_) as a “resident pupil” (_antevāsi_) lives with the teacher.
sn35.151:1.8: The defilements “master” (_samudācaranti_) them like a “teaching master” (_ācariya_).
